name: Reactoonz

features.name: Quantum Leap meter
features.description: Winning symbols charge a meter that triggers random grid modifiers.

features.name: Gargantoon
features.description: A fully charged meter releases a giant wild that splits into smaller wilds.

review: Reactoonz has no traditional free spins – its features trigger from a charge meter that fills with every winning cluster. That design keeps the base game busy, and the Gargantoon feature is still one of the most enjoyable moments in any cluster slot. It remains one of Play'n GO's best games years after release.
pros: No-free-spins design that still feels rewarding
